description.narrative: (Somalia): With FY 2024 resources, USAID, in coordination with the Federal Government of Somalia and in collaboration with the Department of Defense and State Department, will support community-driven stabilization activities that increase the legitimacy of local authorities and support them to manage conflict and prevent a resurgence of violence. USAID will help establish the conditions to build local institutions that are inclusive, responsive, and accountable to all groups, including minority and marginalized populations. USAID will continue to prioritize areas recently recovered from al-Shabaab. Furthermore, USAID's stabilization programs will continue to support community-prioritized development activities to demonstrate the positive impact of political reconciliation and assist in rebuilding relationships between the government and local communities. USAID will create platforms and mechanisms that bring communities together to identify sources of conflict and conduct activities that address grievances and rebuild trust between conflicting groups. .In addition, USAID, with FY 2024 resources, will work to increase the participation of youth and other marginalized groups in local governance. Leveraging women's role as peace builders and mediators in times of conflict, USAID will seek to increase women's participation in newly constituted governance structures in recently stabilized communities. In particular, Gender Equity and Equality Action Fund Priority 5 will expand women's access to political, economic, and social opportunities and strengthen their capacity to be active decision-makers in political and economic arenas. ....
